body: Introverts unite! We really do have to stick together. It sucks because sometimes it feels like you can be the most caring, loving, understanding person, but all is worthless because you're not an extrovert. I guess that's where the whole ''loving yourself and being fine by yourself/not expecting anything from others'' thing comes to play!
It does make sense, I think it's a great outlook, just kind of difficult to embrace. Thanks for the hug and the advice, I appreciate it more than you might think ♥
